docs.description: Vertical stack of Option Rows that share one question — the fieldset around a group of checkboxes, radios or toggles. Single variant; Content is a slot for Option Row instances. Wrap it in fieldset + legend; the legend is visually hidden when the question already appears as a heading. Keep one control type per list. Above five mutually exclusive options use Select.

rules.reason: The fieldset around Option Rows that answer one question, as the description says: a <fieldset> on the web with its legend hidden, read by a screen reader (owner decision 2026-09-24: Figma draws no legend); a group named by its label in Flutter. Bespoke on both, its content the caller's rows.
